company: Macquarie Data Centres (Macquarie Technology Group, ASX:MAQ)
source_passage: Data-centre/colocation, cloud and cybersecurity provider — high-data-sensitivity sector and an extreme high-value-target profile (secure internet gateway and cyber provider to ~42% of the Australian Federal Government, the ATO, and Defence-ready workloads). However, NO breach was found (UpGuard 'A', 843/950), and as a cybersecurity provider itself it is likely sophisticated and may self-insure or carry bespoke cover — lowering pitch amenability despite the large blast-radius exposure. The concentration risk is the strongest angle. NOTE: distinct from Macquarie Group/Macquarie Bank (MQG). No data breach/ransomware/OAIC NDB found; UpGuard 'A' (843/950); minor hygiene gaps (DMARC p=none, no DNSSEC/CAA, CSP unsafe-eval) Concentration/high-value-target risk: secure internet gateway + cyber provider for ~42% of the Australian Federal Government and the ATO; hosts sovereign/Defence workloads (medium-severity inherent risk, not an incident) Multi-tenant colocation aggregation risk: hosts two-thirds of global public-cloud hyperscalers and government in shared Intellicentre campuses — concentrated third-party/supply-chain exposure Parent: Macquarie Technology Group Limited (ASX:MAQ; formerly Macquarie Telecom Group) — NOT Macquarie Group/Bank (MQG) Sister units: Macquarie Cloud Services, Macquarie Government, Macquarie Telecom Major government customer: ATO (secure internet gateway/SOC since 2019; renewal Jan 2023; cumulative ~A$86.1m) Partners/tenants: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Tech suppliers: Cisco, VMware, Dell, Fortinet, Red Hat External auditor of parent: PwC (distinct from PwC's audit of Macquarie Group/Bank) Competitors: NEXTDC, Equinix, AirTrunk, Global Switch, CDC
triples: parent of Macquarie Technology Group Limited
